places.name: Canyon centreline

ground.note: No pgmvox op takes a cross-section: landform.canyon only cuts, relative to the ground it follows (depth, width, floor, wall, ledges). On the red half this stage moves 598,159 of the ~718,000 height-blocks the heightfield stages move in all (measured, order-dependent).
Gullies where Fort Road, Ranch Road and the Grove Track go down. 42,078 height-blocks (red half).

pieces.note: Obsidian 79..82, lava inside, bottom 5 blocks over ground 73 (74..78 air). By the studio's rule a core leaks at y <= 79 - 5 - 1 = 73, which is the ground the well opens in: lava from the foot falls straight to the void.
